items.title: Aaron and Miriam
items.charge: Speaking against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman, and claiming an equal standing: hath he not spoken also by us?

items.title: Adoni-bezek
items.charge: Mutilating seventy kings and feeding them under his table

items.title: Ahaz
items.charge: Molten images for Baalim; burning his children in the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom; hiring Assyria with the treasure of the Lord’s house; sacrificing to the gods of Damascus that smote him; cutting the vessels in pieces and shutting up the doors of the house of the Lord

items.title: Asa in his latter years
items.charge: Relying on the king of Syria and not on the Lord; putting the seer in a prison house for the rebuke; in his disease seeking not to the Lord, but to the physicians

items.title: Caiaphas and the council
items.charge: Seeking false witness against Christ; condemning him by night; delivering him to the Gentiles; forbidding the apostles; stoning Stephen

items.title: David and Bathsheba
items.charge: Adultery with the wife of Uriah, and setting Uriah up to be murdered on the battlefield to cover it

items.title: Elymas the sorcerer
items.charge: Withstanding the apostles; seeking to turn the deputy from the faith

items.title: Gideon’s ephod
items.charge: Making an ephod of the golden earrings of the spoil, and putting it in Ophrah; all Israel going a whoring after it

items.title: Jehoahaz of Israel
items.charge: Doing evil in the sight of the Lord and following the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, departing not therefrom; beseeching the Lord under the oppression of Syria, and not departing from the sins of the house of Jeroboam when the saviour came

items.title: Jehoash of Israel and the arrows
items.charge: Doing evil and departing not from the sins of Jeroboam; smiting the ground thrice with the arrows and staying, when the man of God had put his hands on his hands

items.title: Jehoshaphat’s alliances
items.charge: Joining affinity with Ahab and going up with him to Ramoth-gilead against the word of the prophet; joining himself with Ahaziah to make ships

items.title: Jehu
items.charge: Executing the house of Ahab and destroying Baal out of Israel, and then not departing from the golden calves at Bethel and Dan; taking no heed to walk in the law of the Lord with all his heart

items.title: King Solomon
items.charge: Loving many strange women of the nations the Lord had forbidden; multiplying wives against the law of the king; building high places for Chemosh and Molech

items.title: Nazareth, his own country
items.charge: Being offended at him; seeking to cast him down the hill

items.title: Nebuchadnezzar
items.charge: Pride: is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?

items.title: Rehoboam
items.charge: Forsaking the counsel of the old men for the young men he grew up with; and forsaking the law of the Lord when the kingdom was established

items.title: The magistrates of Philippi
items.charge: Beating and imprisoning uncondemned Romans on the word of a mob

items.title: The manna hoarders
items.charge: Keeping manna overnight; going out to gather on the Sabbath

items.title: The seven sons of Sceva
items.charge: Exorcising in the name of Jesus whom Paul preacheth

items.title: The traders in the temple
items.charge: Making the house of prayer a den of thieves

items.title: The young mockers of Bethel
items.charge: Mocking the prophet of the Lord: go up, thou bald head

items.title: Uzziah
items.charge: Going into the temple of the Lord to burn incense upon the altar of incense, which appertaineth not unto the king but to the priests the sons of Aaron; and raging at the priests who withstood him

items.title: Zacharias
items.charge: Not believing the words of the angel Gabriel, and asking for a sign
